meta.source: openICPSR 100707 - UCR Offenses Known and Clearances by Arrest (Return A), 1960-2024
meta.caveat: Regions are contiguous groups of counties within one state, merged until they reach a population floor so that a handful of offences stops moving the rate. Membership is fixed across all years and committed, so a rebuild cannot move a boundary. Murder remains noisy at any sub-state size: a 100,000-person region expects about 6.5 murders a year, so its murder rate carries roughly 39% error.
